collection_name: IndicVoices — Telugu
organization: AI4Bharat (IIT Madras), funded by MeitY / Bhashini
description: Large natural-speech collection (read 8%, extempore 76%, conversational 15%) from 22,563 speakers across 208 districts and 22 languages; Telugu config 'telugu'. Transcribed subset released progressively.
size_telugu: Unknown per-language (gated); overall 12,000 h collected, 3,200 h transcribed with median 122 h per language (README)
metadata_fields: speaker id; gender; age group; district; state; task type; domain
acquisition_method: Accept terms on HF (ai4bharat/IndicVoices), load config 'telugu' with token.
verification_method: GitHub README (overall stats) + HF API (licence, gated, 'telugu' config)
unresolved_issues: Telugu hours not visible without login.
processing_needs: Rich district metadata — useful for dialect-aware ASR.

collection_name: IndicVoices-R — Telugu (TTS-grade restored speech)
description: Enhanced/restored subset of IndicVoices suitable for TTS training (NeurIPS 2024 D&B), Telugu config present.
size_telugu: Unknown (gated)
acquisition_method: Accept terms on HF and load config 'Telugu'.
verification_method: HF API (licence, gated, configs)
unresolved_issues: Telugu hours not visible without login (card is gated); overall hours not confirmed from an accessible source.

collection_name: Kathbath (IndicSUPERB) — Telugu
description: Read speech (IndicCorp sentences) recorded via crowdsourcing on phones, with clean and noisy test sets; also used for speaker verification, LID, query-by-example and keyword spotting.
size_telugu: 154.9 h; 53 male + 51 female speakers; 147k-word vocabulary
acquisition_method: Download tar files from objectstore links in the IndicSUPERB README, or accept terms on HF ai4bharat/kathbath (config 'telugu').
license: CC0 1.0 (IndicSUPERB README); HF repo tagged CC BY 4.0
copyright_notes: Text prompts come from IndicCorp (web crawl) — AI4Bharat states it does not own the raw text.
verification_method: GitHub README statistics table and licence section read
unresolved_issues: HF tag (CC BY 4.0) differs from README (CC0) — both permissive.

collection_name: Shrutilipi — Telugu (All India Radio news, mined)

collection_name: Vaani — Telugu districts (audio + images, partially transcribed)
